title: South Africa is betting on WhatsApp to bring Gen Z back to the ballot box
interpretation: South Africa using WhatsApp to engage with Gen Z voters showcases the growing importance of digital platforms for democratic participation, indicating that technology will be a crucial driver of voter turnout in future elections.
opportunity: Financial technology companies that develop innovative solutions for voter registration, campaign funding, and election monitoring may see significant growth as governments and civil society organizations prioritize digital engagement in elections.
risk: Dependence on a single social media platform like WhatsApp for disseminating electoral information increases the risk of misinformation and election interference, potentially undermining the integrity of the electoral process.
